question: Which bank contact in New York asked me to find out why the guaranty with Enron's London metals entity hasn't been put in place yet?

Plan: find emails about a guaranty for Enron's London metals entity, identify the New York bank contact who asked me to chase it, and confirm by reading the email.

answer:
It was Mike (Michael) Mulligan of BNP Paribas in New York.

On 2001-10-17 you wrote to Matthew Dawson. You said you'd had a call from "my buddy Mike Mulligan with Paribas in NY last night" asking you to check on "the status of the guaranty he is trying to get in place with Enron Metals Limited." He said he had been trying to get it in place with London "for some time." You asked whether a particular problem was holding it up and offered to help get the guaranty to Paribas.

Mulligan has written to you before about Enron parent guaranties. In February 2000 he needed the Enron Corp. parent guaranty amended to cover an Enron London entity after his traders had dealt with it. In August 2000 he asked you to amend the guaranty to include the Enron physical entity. His address in those emails is at Paribas / BNP Paribas Americas.
